second_source.name: private lab experiments.db
second_source.note: The evaluation corpus is not reproducible from this manifest alone. It also contains protocols and reagents exported from a private laboratory SQLite database, which is not public and is not in this repository. Rebuild those with tools/export_experiments_db.py, tools/clean_corpus_csv.py and tools/merge_corpus_csv.py against your own database.
second_source.eval_questions_depending_on_it: Roughly a quarter of eval/questions.yaml labels resolve only against the lab half. Without it, check_labels reports those doc_ids as unknown; that is expected, not a broken question set.
